order_mode.label: Question order

invite.title: Send invitation by email
invite.description: Paste respondent emails to invite. Each gets a separate email from pozvanky@subenai.sk with the test link.
invite.recipients_placeholder:
anna@example.com, jan@example.com
or one per line
invite.invalid_hint: Some addresses are not valid (e.g. {example}). They will be skipped.
invite.include_password_label: Include password in the email body
invite.include_password_hint: By default we do NOT email the password — the author shares it separately (SMS, chat, in person). Check only if you're OK with this.
invite.include_password_warning: Including the password weakens the second factor — anyone with access to the recipient's inbox also has the password. Better: send the password via a separate channel.
